$schema-note: Dated + justified allowlist for the vinext PRE-COMPILE CLOSURE supply-chain gate (scripts/precompile-closure-audit.mjs, ADR-0042 C6 / #764). Mirrors security/npm-audit-allowlist.json and the Trivy triage discipline: an accepted HIGH/CRITICAL in the closure that feeds `vite build` is suppressed ONLY by an entry here, so the gate can never be silently neutered. Each entry MUST carry: `id` (a GHSA/CVE id), `justification` (why it is accepted — no fix available, not reachable in our usage, etc.), and `added` (ISO date). `expires` (ISO date) is optional; past its expiry the entry stops suppressing and the risk must be re-justified. `note` (free text) is the only other permitted key: an entry carrying any key outside [id, justification, added, expires, note] makes the gate THROW, because a misspelled `expires` would otherwise be silently ignored and the entry would never expire while reading as though it does. A malformed entry makes the gate THROW rather than be ignored. Bump the dependency FIRST (as nanoid 3.3.17 -> 3.3.18 was, via an override in examples/bun-exec/package.json); allowlist only when there is no fix. SCOPE, stated because it is a real widening: this ONE file backs BOTH closures the gate audits — `--closure examples/bun-exec` and `--app apps/file-manager` (C1/#785) — so an entry accepted for one suppresses the same advisory in the other. Every justification must therefore name the closure and the reachability argument it rests on, and an entry whose argument holds only for one closure must be re-examined, not renewed, if the other starts carrying the same package.

allow.justification: image-size 2.0.2: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops. NO FIXED VERSION published upstream at the time of acceptance (advisory range <= 2.0.2, first_patched_version null). BE PRECISE ABOUT REACHABILITY, because an earlier draft of this entry got it wrong: image-size is NOT a build-only transitive dependency. It is a DIRECT, exactly-pinned dependency of vinext ("image-size": "2.0.2" in vinext's package.json) and it is imported SERVER-SIDE at vinext/dist/server/metadata-route-build-data.js, so `resolve.noExternal` inlines it into the compiled binary and it runs in production. Accepted anyway because of WHERE ITS INPUT COMES FROM: the buffer it parses is `fs.readFileSync(route.filePath)` over repo-owned metadata images (icon/opengraph-image and friends) resolved from the app's own source tree at build/serve time — never from request bytes, an uploaded file, or a URL. An attacker who can supply that buffer already commits to the repository. Re-check at expiry: if a fix exists, bump instead of renewing; if metadata-route handling ever reads image bytes from a request, this entry must be dropped, not renewed.

image-size 2.0.2: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop. Same package, same version, same posture as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: no fixed version upstream at acceptance, and image-size is a DIRECT dependency of vinext imported server-side (vinext/dist/server/metadata-route-build-data.js), hence inlined into the compiled binary — accepted because the only buffers it parses are `fs.readFileSync` of repo-owned metadata image files, never request data. Re-check at expiry on the same terms.

decode-uri-component 0.2.2 (quadratic-time DoS in percent-decoding; fixed only in 0.5.1, advisory range <= 0.5.0). Pulled ONLY via query-string@7.1.3 <- minio@8.0.6 <- @getknext/lib (runtime, bundled into the closure). The bump is NOT taken: 0.5.1 is ESM-only (type: module, default export) and query-string 7 require()s it expecting a CJS function, so `query-string.parse` throws `decodeComponent is not a function` (verified under node 24 and bun 1.4.2); minio 8.0.7 (latest) still pins query-string ^7.1.3, so no clean upgrade path exists. REACHABILITY: the decode path is reached only through query-string's parse/extract, and minio's dist calls only `qs.stringify` (internal/client.js, helpers.js) — no request or response bytes are ever decoded by this package. The module is loaded but its quadratic decode routine is never invoked. Applies identically to every closure that carries minio (apps/docs, apps/file-manager, the published @getknext/lib closure). Re-check at expiry: if minio moves to a query-string that pulls a fixed decode-uri-component, or query-string is replaced, bump and drop this entry rather than renewing it; if any code calls query-string.parse on untrusted input, this entry must be dropped and the path fixed. PATCH ROUTE considered and rejected: a bun patchedDependencies edit of query-string 7.1.3 (loading decode-uri-component's `.default`) only changes THIS repo's install; consumers of the published @getknext/lib resolve minio -> query-string -> decode-uri-component themselves, so the published closure would still carry 0.2.2, and the patch would fork a third-party package we then have to maintain.
